g.text: the checks of decision 67: in play and in replay
read the config (reserved on the budget of the deploy)
the family, the params, the dimensions, the capacity
a text, or a numeric vector of the dimensions
with finite f32 values? (else DimensionMismatch or BadArgument)
a map of the one key k, an Int in [1, capacity]?
the ids and distances of at most k neighbours
of the last repair that finished
produce the reply on ret, recorded:
eligible: only stored records whose id is in ids
a stale id names no record and selects nothing
the exact order decides among the others
The ids are hints. Only the exact query
param ids= turns them into a decision,
so a stale mirror gives weaker advice
the same checks, the same host work
produce the recorded reply on ret
the same exact query, the same decision
the records of the space: its config
the event log of the deploy
the space agent: the exact engine
